spans.s:
अहेतु m. (-तुः) Absence of cause or reason.
 E. अ neg. हेतु cause.

अहेतुक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Causeless, groundless.
 E. अ neg. हेतुक having
cause.

अहेतुता f. (-ता) Absence of cause or necessity.
 E. तल् added to अहेतु.

अहेतुत्व n. (-त्वं) Absence of reason or cause.
 E. त्व added to अहेतु.

अहेरु f. (-रुः) A plant, (Asparagus racemosus:) see शतमूली.
 E. अ neg.
हि to go, and रु affix; immoveable; alluding to the number of its
roots.

आहेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Belonging or relating to a snake.
 E. अहि a snake,
and ढञ् aff.
